import json
R,C=22,26
g=[[0]*C for _ in range(R)]
def rect(r1,r2,c1,c2,border,fill=None):
    for r in range(r1,r2+1):
        for c in range(c1,c2+1):
            if r in (r1,r2) or c in (c1,c2): g[r][c]=border
            elif fill is not None: g[r][c]=fill if (r-r1-1+c-c1-1)%2==0 else 0
rect(1,6,3,11,1,4)
rect(10,13,2,5,2,8)
rect(9,16,11,21,3,4)
print(json.dumps(g,separators=(',',':')))
